description: Island hopping, the Langkawi Sky Bridge cable car, mangrove kayaking and a sunset beach dinner at Pantai Cenang.
UNESCO heritage walk, street art trail, Kek Lok Si Temple and a guided street food tour of Gurney Drive and Chulia Street.
Boh tea plantation visit, strawberry farms, Mossy Forest guided trek and cool highland evenings.
A Famosa, Christ Church, Jonker Street night market and a river cruise through the historic city centre.
Crystal-clear water, snorkelling with turtles and reef sharks, and a relaxing stay by the beach.
Bako National Park wildlife trek, Semenggoh orangutan centre, a longhouse visit and Sarawak laksa tasting.
Kinabalu Park, Poring hot springs, the canopy walk and sunrise views over the highest peak in Malaysia.
River cruise, canopy walkway and a jungle trek through one of the oldest rainforests in the world.
Petronas Towers, KL Tower, Batu Caves, Central Market and Jalan Alor street food.
Snorkelling at Marine Park Island, jungle waterfalls and white sandy beaches for a short island escape.
Limestone cave temples, old town murals, white coffee tasting and the famous Ipoh bean sprout chicken.
Island hopping at Mabul and Mataking, plus a world-class diving and snorkelling experience.
